description: Election Commission - S. M. S. Samarakoon was selected as the member of the Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
